<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.button-advies');

    function getVacancyNumber() {
        var vacancyNumber = '';

        document.querySelectorAll('.elementor-icon-list-text').forEach(function (element) {
            var text = element.textContent.trim();

            if (text.indexOf('Vacaturenummer:') === 0) {
                vacancyNumber = text.replace('Vacaturenummer:', '').trim();
            }
        });

        return vacancyNumber;
    }

    buttons.forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            event.preventDefault();

            var url = new URL('/formulier-advies/', window.location.origin);
            var vacancyNumber = getVacancyNumber();

            if (vacancyNumber) {
                url.searchParams.set('vacaturenummer', vacancyNumber);
            }

            window.location.href = url.toString();
        });
    });
});
</script>
